rationale: The stock gapped up ~13% on no news catalyst visible in the last 24 hours, opened at $48.06, hit a high of $48.56, and has since pulled back to $46.74 — now trading below both VWAP ($47.07) and the 9-EMA ($47.24), suggesting the gap-up momentum has faded.
